beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "We landed a commission neither of us has actually built before. My partner thinks I'm the one who should figure it out."

options.text: Do you think you can figure it out?
Sounds like you're in over your head.
Why would he ask you specifically?

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Technically? Maybe. I just don't feel ready."

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: You turn over the top card.

options.text: You already have everything you need for this.
You'll need to learn a whole new skill first.
This card means you should turn the job down.

elaboration: The Magician doesn't hand you anything new — it points at tools already on the table and says: those are enough.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "I don't have the resources for this one, though. Not really."

options.text: Skill, focus, the right words when you need them — that's the resource.
You're right, this is out of your depth.

elaboration: Magic hides in ordinary things — available only to those who actually know how to look for it.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "...Alright. I think I can start tomorrow with what's already in the shop."
